digest.component_or_area: RunRequest builder for single-turn structured LLM calls
propositions: Fourteen call sites in src/rebar/llm hand-build identical single-turn structured request shapes with no enforcement of the RunRequest contract that mode and execution_mode must be consistent

Bounding decisions (output_token_limit, structured_retry_limit, transport_attempt_limit, request_timeout_limit_s) are omitted at thirteen of fourteen sites, making unbounded sites indistinguishable from deliberately-unbounded ones
A shared constructor with required bounds argument will make the bounding decision explicit and enforce the mode+execution_mode contract
The builder adoption at fourteen sites produces byte-identical RunRequest objects while making bounds visibility mandatory via a greppable bounds= parameter
The existing site oracle in test_subcall_class_selection.py must recognize RunRequest.for_structured in addition to direct RunRequest calls to avoid failing open after adoption
Guard construction prevents hand-built single-turn structured requests outside runner.py unless reasoned with a # single-turn-structured-ok marker
